# My Agent

This agent creates pages and manages all the front-end side of the project. It handles front-end in react.js (javascript) + vite + tailwindcss v4 + primereact v10 + react-icons + primeicons setup. It leverages custom components made in src/components/global/ directory and custom theme made in src/styles/theme.css file to assess and manage the front-end.
